description: Post-lowering AST conformance for grids/cartesian_uniform_1d/rules/central_D2_periodic. Every binding loads fixture.esm (N bound to 8 at the import edge), runs the section-9.6.3 rewrite fixpoint, and must emit a byte-identical expanded AST: the compound D(D(u,x),x) replaced by the rule's makearray (interior 3-point second-order stencil aggregate over [2,7]; the two periodic-wrap faces at i=1,8), zero apply_expression_template nodes, zero unlowered rewrite-target ops, zero surviving metaparameter names, with the free name dx surviving. The golden is generated by the Julia reference runner only (scripts/regenerate-goldens.sh) and compared bytewise by the other bindings.
